themes.label: Teaching practice & curriculum design
themes.blurb: Pedagogy, active and problem-based learning, flipped classrooms, course and programme design, experiential and service learning, study skills and metacognition.

themes.label: Digital, simulation & immersive learning
themes.blurb: Learning technology, blended and online delivery, lecture capture, generative AI, simulation, virtual reality, 3D printing, anatomical visualisation and learning analytics.

themes.label: Assessment, feedback & academic integrity
themes.blurb: Assessment design, authentic and programmatic assessment, feedback, OSCEs, marking and moderation, plagiarism and academic integrity.

themes.label: Inclusive education & student wellbeing
themes.blurb: EDI, decolonising the curriculum, accessibility and disability, neurodiversity, belonging, awarding gaps, and the wellbeing and mental health of students and staff.

themes.label: Employability, skills & professional identity
themes.blurb: Graduate attributes, work-based learning, placements and clerkships, careers, interprofessional education, and professional and clinical skills.

themes.label: Transitions, engagement & student voice
themes.blurb: Transition and induction, first-year experience, retention, student–staff partnership and co-creation, peer-assisted learning, and widening access outreach.

themes.label: Sustainability & global/civic education
themes.blurb: Sustainability and the SDGs, planetary and global health, civic and public engagement, and global citizenship.

cross.label: SoTL methods, data & open scholarship
cross.blurb: Cross-cutting. Research methods and study design, statistics and data skills, open and reproducible scholarship, OERs, evaluation and review methodology.
